entity: Grain Processing Corporation's Muscatine, Iowa corn mill: failed stack tests with no state enforcement orders, 2015-25
what_we_add: 49 failed-test days 2015-25, #1 of 29 big wet corn mills, 0 Iowa orders vs 7 Indiana orders at the twin plant, Iowa 19 vs Indiana 572 statewide
why: Center for Public Integrity names GPC and states the same finding in words: 38 air violations in a decade, penalties only twice - persistent violations, weak Iowa enforcement. Its window is 2001-2011, ours 2015-25, but the finding matches in direction; our whole number line and the Indiana comparison are ours alone.
